scenes.title: 비행에서 무엇을 관찰할까
lines: Superflight is a game about flying between obstacles.
For now, watch the character rather than the score.
We will separately observe where the marked torso point moves on screen and how the body tilts.
The red displacement line shows an observed screen change, not an internal game coordinate.

scenes.title: 몸의 자를 바깥 기준으로 읽기
lines: Imagine one set of rulers attached to the body and another fixed in a room.
The same arrow receives different numbers depending on which rulers we use.
A rotation matrix records where the three body rulers point when read in the room frame.

scenes.title: 축 방향의 몫과 전치
lines: Previously, we converted body-frame numbers into an external frame.
Now we read how much of an external arrow lies along each body axis.
A dot product reads that component.
Transposition exchanges rows and columns for this calculation.

scenes.title: 길이와 직각부터 검사하기
lines: Not every numerical set of axes is a rotation matrix.
If the rulers stretch or become oblique, the object becomes distorted.
We therefore check axis lengths, right angles and handedness.
The next equations summarize those checks.

scenes.title: 평행한 조각을 빼는 교정
lines: Subtracting the part parallel to the first ruler leaves only the perpendicular part of a slightly skewed second ruler.
We then restore its length to one.
That is the idea behind the next correction.
A vanished ruler or initially parallel input needs separate handling.

scenes.title: 중간 자세도 같은 검사로 확인
lines: Knowing a starting and target orientation does not automatically give a valid intermediate orientation.
Averaging the numbers of two matrices can destroy the axis lengths we checked earlier.
We will use that same length check to see the problem.
